The annual tuition fee for a third-year ENTC student for the academic year 2026-27 is ₹1,30,000 [SQL]. 

As per the Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27, the tuition fee is billed annually and is payable in two instalments, where Instalment 1 is 60% of the annual tuition and Instalment 2 is 40% [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §2 Fee components].
sql: SELECT f.amount AS annual_tuition FROM fee_structure AS f JOIN departments AS d ON f.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.code = 'ENTC' AND f.year_of_study = 3 AND f.component = 'tuition' AND f.academic_year = '2026-27' LIMIT 50
